text: The LORD will sustain and strengthen him on his sickbed; In his illness, You will restore him to health.
Even my own close friend in whom I trusted, Who ate my bread, Has lifted up his heel against me [betraying me].
As for me, You uphold me in my integrity, And You set me in Your presence forever.
Blessed be the LORD, the God of Israel, From everlasting to everlasting [from this age to the next, and forever]. Amen and Amen (so be it).
